title: From grey relational-network pharmacology screening to mechanism elucidation: 4-methoxy-2- (3-methylethoxyethane) -phenylisobutyrate from Pimpinella diversifolia essential oil alleviates D-GalN/LPS-induced ALI by targeting the GSK-3beta/NF-kappaB axis.
authors: Tang, Ruonan; Peng, Suyu; Wang, Jiawen; Liu, Yu; Qin, Runze; Huang, Zixin; Cao, Ruoning; Zhang, Chunchun; Li, Meiya; Jiang, Fusheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物精油成分通过靶向GSK-3beta/NF-kappaB信号轴缓解急性肝损伤，属于药物-蛋白互作，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Pimpinella diversifolia DC. is a traditional medicinal herb used in She and Miao ethnic medicine. Its root essential oil (PDREO) has demonstrated hepatoprotective effects, but its active constituents and the underlying mechanisms against acute liver injury (ALI) remain unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to systematically identify the key anti-inflammatory and antioxidant components in PDREO and to elucidate their molecular mechanisms of action against ALI. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The protective effect of PDREO was evaluated in a D-galactosamine/lipopolysaccharide (D-GalN/LPS)-induced ALI mouse model. PDREO was fractionated via silica gel chromatography, and the anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities of the fractions and PDREO were assessed in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages. Bioactive components were screened using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) fingerprinting combined with grey relational analysis. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to predict targets, followed by validation using cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) and bio-layer interferometry (BLI). The mechanisms of the lead compound were further investigated in vitro and in vivo. RESULTS: PDREO significantly ameliorated D-GalN/LPS-induced liver damage, inflammation, and oxidative stress in mice. Six bioactive compounds were identified, among which 4-methoxy-2-(3-methyloxiranyl)phenyl isobutyrate (compound P59) exhibited the most potent activity. Network pharmacology and molecular docking predicted glycogen synthase kinase 3beta (GSK-3beta) as a key target. CETSA and BLI confirmed the direct binding of P59 to GSK-3beta. Mechanistically, P59 promoted the inhibitory phosphorylation of GSK-3beta, subsequently suppressed NF-kappaB p65 nuclear translocation, and downregulated pro-inflammatory cytokines. These effects were consistently observed in both LPS-stimulated macrophages and the D-GalN/LPS-induced ALI mouse model. Furthermore, p65 overexpression abrogated the inhibitory effect of P59 on pro-inflammatory cytokine secretion, validating NF-kappaB as the essential downstream effector of the GSK-3beta/NF-kappaB axis. CONCLUSION: This study reveals that PDREO alleviates ALI through its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Compound P59 is identified as a pivotal active constituent that exerts hepatoprotection by directly targeting GSK-3beta and inhibiting the GSK-3beta/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Our findings provide a pharmacological basis for the traditional use of P. diversifolia and highlight P59 as a promising candidate for ALI drug development.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性： 茴芹（Pimpinella diversifolia DC.）是畲族和苗族医学中使用的传统草药。其根精油（PDREO）已显示出保肝作用，但其活性成分及针对急性肝损伤（ALI）的潜在机制尚不清楚。研究目的： 本研究旨在系统鉴定PDREO中的关键抗炎和抗氧化成分，并阐明其对抗ALI的分子作用机制。材料与方法： 在D-半乳糖胺/脂多糖（D-GalN/LPS）诱导的ALI小鼠模型中评估了PDREO的保护作用。通过硅胶色谱法对PDREO进行分级，并在LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中评估各馏分和PDREO的抗炎及抗氧化活性。采用气相色谱-质谱联用（GC-MS）指纹图谱结合灰色关联分析筛选生物活性成分。利用网络药理学和分子对接预测靶点，随后通过细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和生物层干涉法（BLI）进行验证。进一步在体外和体内研究了先导化合物的机制。结果： PDREO显著改善了D-GalN/LPS诱导的小鼠肝损伤、炎症和氧化应激。鉴定出六种生物活性化合物，其中4-甲氧基-2-(3-甲基环氧乙烷基)苯基异丁酸酯（化合物P59）表现出最强的活性。网络药理学和分子对接预测糖原合成酶激酶3β（GSK-3β）为关键靶点。CETSA和BLI确认了P59与GSK-3β的直接结合。机制上，P59促进GSK-3β的抑制性磷酸化，随后抑制NF-κB p65核转位，并下调促炎细胞因子。这些效应在LPS刺激的巨噬细胞和D-GalN/LPS诱导的ALI小鼠模型中均一致观察到。此外，p65过表达消除了P59对促炎细胞因子分泌的抑制作用，验证了NF-κB是GSK-3β/NF-κB轴的关键下游效应因子。结论： 本研究揭示PDREO通过其抗炎和抗氧化特性缓解ALI。化合物P59被鉴定为关键活性成分，通过直接靶向GSK-3β并抑制GSK-3β/NF-κB信号通路发挥保肝作用。我们的发现为茴芹的传统用途提供了药理学基础，并突出P59作为ALI药物开发的有前景候选物。
